<p class="eyebrow">Bio / Profile</p>
<h1 class="landing-title">Macro research, public-data systems, and interpretable market state updating.</h1>
<p class="landing-copy">I am Jaeseok Hwang, a Ph.D. candidate in Applied Economics at UIUC. My current work focuses on building a research-grade rates and cross-asset scenario updating system that separates prior expectation, new shock, realized reaction, covariance-path belief, and ex-post story review.</p>

<p>U.S. Treasury and cross-asset research stack with scenario memory, covariance-path beliefs, post-close review, and multi-horizon forecast leaves.</p>

<h2 class="dashboard-title">Treasury / cross-asset scenario dashboard</h2>
<p class="dashboard-intro">This panel is the homepage view of the current research system. The full Quarto page holds the full process logic, operating cycle, and research framing.</p>

<div class="status-strip">
<span class="status-chip">Daily post-close update</span>
<span class="status-chip">Weekly narrative review</span>
<span class="status-chip">Monthly regime tracking</span>
</div>

<div class="dashboard-mini-grid">
<div class="dashboard-card compact">
<p class="dashboard-card-label">State update</p>
<h3>Prior → shock → reaction → posterior</h3>
<p>Yesterday's posterior becomes today's prior. After the close, structured shock interpretation and realized market reaction update the scenario state.</p>
</div>
<div class="dashboard-card compact">
<p class="dashboard-card-label">Covariance path</p>
<h3>Belief over co-movement</h3>
<p>The system tracks expected volatility and correlation paths across rates, breakeven, credit, USD, equities, oil, and volatility.</p>
</div>
<div class="dashboard-card compact">
<p class="dashboard-card-label">Gap diagnostics</p>
<h3>What the prior missed</h3>
<p>Reaction gap, story-model gap, entropy, explained share, and gap decay are stored as first-class objects rather than side metrics.</p>
</div>
<div class="dashboard-card compact">
<p class="dashboard-card-label">Forecast layer</p>
<h3>Daily / weekly / monthly leaves</h3>
<p>Forecasts are generated from the updated state and unresolved gaps, then reviewed against realized outcomes to learn which paths converge or diverge.</p>
</div>
</div>
